verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can register or connect external MCP servers for those agents to call. The llms.txt file, the agent-readable docs and the OpenAPI schema only make the product easier for outside agents to consume; they are not client-side MCP support and earn no credit here.
